Villa have signed Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, providing additional competition and cover should Martinez leave before the transfer window closes on September 1. "We can share both. Is this scenario a bad scenario? We have two excellent goalkeepers," he said. "Martinez transmitted to us the possibility of having another challenge in his career, not just now but even last year. He was thinking that if he had the opportunity to change his challenge, then he could do it, but he stayed and performed fantastically." Despite the departures, Emery said Villa could rely on the steadfast backing of their supporters, whom he described as the club's most important asset amid a close-season of change. The club have strengthened the squad with several additions, including winger Alejandro Garnacho on loan from Chelsea, central midfielder Joao Gomes from Wolverhampton Wanderers and attacking midfielder Johan Manzambi from Freiburg. Villa have also signed right back Aaron Wan-Bissaka on a season-long loan from West Ham United.

item.title: US health department seeks public feedback on vaccine guidelines after Trump order
item.description: The U.S. health department said on Friday it was seeking public feedback on federal vaccine recommendations, including how they are categorized and communicated, after President Donald Trump's executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccinations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. health department said on Friday it was seeking public feedback on federal vaccine recommendations, including how they are categorized and communicated, after President Donald Trump's executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccinations. The Department of Health and Human Services has posted a notice asking for comments on possible revamped categories, such as whether some vaccines should be recommended but not during infancy, or recommended with qualifications. It has also sought guidance on how recommendations should address timing and sequencing, including whether vaccines could be given within broader age windows or at separate visits. Members of the public, including parents, doctors and health officials, have until September 20, to submit their comments to the health department. Trump signed an [USN:L1N4470Q7 TEXT:"executive order"] earlier this month to limit the inoculation schedule to 11 immunizations, saying it would give U.S. children "gold-standard" protection, and directed officials to review the timing and sequencing of vaccinations. The order advances a long-standing goal of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., an anti-vaccine activist who has promoted a link between vaccines and autism that scientists have repeatedly debunked. Currently, vaccines are categorized as routine for everyone, risk-based for specific groups, or left to shared decision-making between patients and doctors. HHS is specifically seeking feedback on shared decision-making, including its potential risks such as confusion among patients and doctors, lower vaccination rates and added time for clinicians. The agency noted that public trust in federal health authorities fell during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. It cited concerns that some past recommendation processes were seen as rushed or overconfident, which hurt the overall credibility of the vaccine system. The department said the feedback would help inform its consideration of whether the current framework adequately supports scientific rigor, informed choice and public trust.

item.title: Paredes banned for 10 games after World Cup final fracas, Argentina fined
item.description: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the World Cup final while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the [USN:L6N43L0A9 TEXT:"World Cup final"] while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday. A brief scuffle erupted at the final whistle when Argentina midfielder Paredes shoved Spain's Gavi to the ground as the European champions' substitutes rushed onto the pitch to celebrate. Paredes faced [USN:L4N43V1U3 TEXT:"three assault counts"] while Molina faced two. Both players were also fined $90,000 each. Argentina’s Thiago Almada and Spain’s Gavi faced one count each of unsporting behaviour, while Argentina's assistant coach Roberto Ayala faced one assault count. While Almada and Gavi received one-match suspensions, Ayala, who had [USN:L1N43O15D TEXT:"apologised"] for his part in the altercation, was banned for three games, with all three fined $30,000. The Argentinian Football Association (AFA) were fined a total of $321,000 for multiple disciplinary breaches during the World Cup, including the display by some players of [USN:L6N43I178 TEXT:"a banner"] declaring "Las Malvinas Son Argentinas" ("The Falklands are Argentine") following their semi-final win over England. The AFA was also ordered to play Argentina's next two home matches with spectators limited to 50% of capacity. FIFA had said using a sports event for demonstrations of a non-sporting nature was a breach of the disciplinary code. The fines were levied for breaches of the disciplinary code including use of a sports event for non-sporting demonstrations, team misconduct, and discriminatory chants and gestures by fans. "The FIFA Disciplinary Committee further determined that $100,000 of the $321,000 must be invested in a plan to combat discrimination," it said. "The implementation of part of the sanction (one of the two matches and $100,000 of the fine) is suspended, with a probationary period to apply." The decisions remain subject to appeal.

item.title: Fifa pune Argentina por faixa sobre Malvinas e Paredes por incidente na final da Copa do Mundo
item.description: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de 321 mil dólares à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de 321 mil dólares à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo. A punição também se deve a cantos e gestos discriminatórios por parte de seus torcedores. A Comissão Disciplinar determinou, além disso, que a AFA dispute as próximas duas partidas em casa com uma restrição de 50% no número de espectadores. Também determinou punições a jogadores por incidentes ocorridos depois que a Espanha se sagrou campeã mundial ao vencer a Argentina por 1 x 0. A punição mais severa recaiu sobre o meio-campista argentino Leandro Paredes, que recebeu 10 partidas de suspensão e uma multa de 90 mil dólares. A Fifa multou e suspendeu os jogadores argentinos Nahuel Molina e Thiago Almada, bem como o auxiliar técnico da seleção, Roberto Ayala, devido aos incidentes. A Comissão também impôs uma suspensão de uma partida e uma multa de 30 mil dólares ao meio-campista espanhol Gavi por motivos disciplinares.

item.title: Reuters NEXT Gulf leadership summit to return with Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development as exclusive host city partner for next three years
item.dc:creator: Reuters Communications
item.content:encoded: Diplomatic advisor to the United Arab Emirates President Anwar Gargash speaks with Reuters Editor-in-Chief Alessandra Galloni at the Reuters NEXT Gulf Summit, in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, October 22, 2025. REUTERS/Rula Rouhana Reuters announced today that Reuters NEXT Gulf will return on October 21, 2026, bringing its definitive live leadership summit back to Abu Dhabi following the success of its inaugural event last year. The Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development will continue as the exclusive host city partner for Reuters NEXT Gulf over the next three years, building on the success of the summit's inaugural edition in 2025. "In 2025, we brought Reuters NEXT to the Gulf because the region's trajectory demands a summit equal to its ambition,” said Josh London, Head of Reuters Professional. “In 2026, that case is even stronger. At a time of uncertainty across the Middle East, Reuters NEXT Gulf will give decision-makers unfiltered access to the people moving markets, shaping policy, managing risk and investing in the future." His Excellency Ahmed Jasim Al Zaabi, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development, said: "Abu Dhabi is a powerful convener of leaders, decision-makers, innovators, senior executives, and media. Such gatherings enable the dialogue and partnerships needed to drive investment and economic growth in a rapidly changing world. Abu Dhabi's leadership in sectors including financial services, advanced manufacturing, AI, trade, logistics, and new energy makes it a natural platform for global conversations about the future economy." Al Zaabi added "The return of Reuters NEXT Gulf reflects Abu Dhabi's growing role in shaping global economic conversations. As the emirate advances its long-term economic transformation agenda, forums such as Reuters NEXT Gulf provide an important platform to exchange ideas, strengthen partnerships and explore the opportunities that will define the next phase of global growth." The decision to bring Reuters NEXT back to Abu Dhabi follows its successful debut in 2025, which convened more than 600 senior executives from 40+ countries in the room and reached 2 million viewers worldwide via livestream. The summit delivered unparalleled access to insights from global leaders, innovators and CEOs tackling defining business and society in a region emerging as a global hub for AI, finance and innovation. More than 30 elite speakers joined the World Stage to address six core themes: Geopolitics, Economy & Markets, Banking & Finance, Technology & AI, Climate & Sustainability, and Corporate Leadership. Speakers from 2025 include: United Arab Emirates Advisor to the President H.E. Dr Anwar Mohammed Gargash Egypt's Minister of Planning, Economic Development & International Cooperation H.E. Dr. Rania Al-Mashat Nigeria's Minister of Foreign Affairs H.E. Yusuf Maitama Tuggar UAE Minister of State H.E. Lana Nusseibeh Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development Chairman H.E Ahmed Jasim Al Zaabi Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund, President & Executive Managing Director H.E. Razan Khalifa Al Mubarak European Union Special Representative for the Gulf Region Luigi Di Maio Emaar Founder and Chairman Mohamed Alabbar   HashKey Exchange CEO Haiyang Ru    Saudi Technology Ventures, Founder & Chief Executive Officer Abdulrahman Tarabzouni Gulf Research Center Chairman Abdulaziz Al Sager Red Sea Global CEO John Pagano Landmark Group Chairwoman Renuka Jagtiani In 2026, Reuters NEXT Gulf will expand the invitation-only gathering with more stages and sessions, executive roundtables and breakouts, vertical-specific strategy sessions and networking opportunities. Visit our website to stay up to date with event announcements and to apply to attend Reuters NEXT Gulf in October 2026. Media Contact: Heather Carpenter Heather.Carpenter @ tr.com

item.title: VW's Blume says overhead costs 30% above rivals, 50,000 jobs figure a guide
item.description: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume said the German carmaker's overhead costs remain over 30% higher than those of comparable firms and that it must reduce that disadvantage to stay competitive, according to an internal company interview.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume said the German carmaker's overhead costs remain over 30% higher than those of comparable firms and that it must reduce that disadvantage to stay competitive, according to an internal company interview. "The frequently cited figure of around 50,000 jobs worldwide is not a fixed target; rather, it is derived from our cost objective relative to the competition and serves as an indicator of the scale of action required," he said in the interview seen by Reuters on Friday. In the face of rising costs and intensifying competition from China, Blume has pledged to overhaul the group, positioning hard decisions about job cuts as necessary for the company's survival. The controlling families behind VW earlier this month dialled up the [USN:L8N4440BK TEXT:"pressure"] on all stakeholders and demanded dramatic restructuring efforts. "We want to be a Volkswagen Group that is successful worldwide, sets technological standards and at the same time remains firmly rooted in Germany," he said. Four Volkswagen plants in Germany -- Emden, Hannover, Zwickau and Neckarsulm -- are not expected to reach competitive capacity utilisation in the 2030s, he said, but stressed that there is no decision yet on specific plant closures. Sites have made progress in some areas, he said, but it is not yet enough, even without considering the pressure from new competitors from China and their plants in Europe.

item.title: Johannesburg pays debt to state utility, averting risk of power being throttled
item.description: South Africa's biggest city Johannesburg has fully settled an overdue debt of 5.25 billion rand ($328 million) owed to state-owned power utility Eskom, the electricity department said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Africa's biggest city Johannesburg has fully settled an overdue debt of 5.25 billion rand ($328 million) owed to state-owned power utility Eskom, the electricity department said on Friday. The settlement follows a government-led mediation process to resolve a [USN:L8N41W1UA TEXT:"long-running billing dispute"] that had threatened to see electricity supply throttled to the economic hub of Africa's biggest economy. The move comes ahead of municipal elections on November 4, when Johannesburg is expected to be among the most-hotly contested battlegrounds. The city is currently governed by a coalition led by the African National Congress, the former liberation movement that also leads the coalition that governs on a national level. The ANC is under pressure to improve service delivery and turn around struggling municipalities after seeing its share of the vote slide at successive elections. Business leaders have pledged to help improve the state of Johannesburg's ailing finances and dilapidated infrastructure, saying the city's condition risks undermining efforts to boost economic growth. ($1 = 16.0144 rand)

item.title: テスラだけで300万台弱、中国が「ドア問題」で過去最大のリコール
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 電気自動車（EV）大手の米テスラなど、自動車メーカー9社でドアハンドルの安全性が問題になっており、中国で400万台余りを対象にリコールが実施される。この問題が原因でドアが開かず、人が車内に閉じ込められ、複数の死亡事故が起きている。

今回のリコールは世界最大の自動車市場である中国で、過去最大規模のものとなる。21日に発表された措置では、テスラが最多を占め、300万台弱が対象となる。

中国国家市場監督管理総局が発表した文書によると、対象となるテスラ車は電気制御式のドアハンドルを採用しており、一部の衝突事故ではこれが作動しなくなる可能性がある。これにより「車内の人がドアを素早く開けて脱出できないほか、車外からの救助活動にも支障を来し、安全上の問題を引き起こす恐れがある」。テスラはリコールの一環として、衝突後に窓を自動的に下げるようソフトウエアを更新し、緊急時のドア解除装置の位置を示す警告ラベルを貼る。

車体と一体化した格納式の電動ドアハンドルを採用した車両では、衝突が起きた場合に電源が失われ、車内に人が閉じ込められる事故が相次いでいる。テスラ車では、高速走行中に衝突した際は生存していたものの、車外に脱出できず、その後に起きた火災で死亡したり重傷を負ったりした事例が複数ある。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースは、こうした最新式のドアシステムについて詳しく報じてきた。テスラ車が衝突して炎上し、ドアを開けられなかった12件の事故で、少なくとも15人が死亡したと明らかにした。またブルームバーグは昨年末、潜在的な安全上の懸念が社内で指摘された後も、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（CEO）が電動ドアの採用にこだわったことも報じている。

中国がこの問題に強い関心を示し始めたのは、小米（シャオミ）の車両を巻き込んだ炎上事故が起きてからだ。同国は2月、EVの格納式ドアハンドルを禁止し、世界で初めてこの設計を違法とした。従来の自動車メーカーのおよそ半分の期間で国産車が開発されている中、安全性の向上を目指し、運転支援技術やバッテリーなどに関する規制も導入されている。

item.title: Rimbalza, ma rialzo rendimenti spinge verso perdite settimanali
item.description: I principali indici azionari statunitensi recuperano terreno dopo il calo della seduta precedente, anche se i mercati sembrano avviati a chiudere la settimana in ribasso, con i rendimenti elevati dei titoli di Stato e le tensioni geopolitiche che hanno pesato sulla propensione al rischio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I principali indici azionari statunitensi recuperano terreno dopo il calo della seduta precedente, anche se i mercati sembrano avviati a chiudere la settimana in ribasso, con i rendimenti elevati dei titoli di Stato e le tensioni geopolitiche che hanno pesato sulla propensione al rischio. ** L’S&P 500 (.SPX) e il Nasdaq (.IXIC) , fortemente esposto al settore tech, si apprestano a interrompere una serie positiva durata tre settimane, mentre il Dow (.DJI) si avvia verso la seconda perdita settimanale consecutiva e il calo settimanale più marcato dalla metà di marzo. ** Il settore finanziario offre il contributo più significativo al mercato: JPMORGAN CHASE (JPM.N) e GOLDMAN SACHS (GS.N) guadagnano l'1% e il 2%, mentre l'indice bancario S&P 500 (.SPXBK) sale dell'1,1%. ** I titoli tech si apprestano a sottoperformare rispetto al resto del mercato, penalizzati dal rialzo dei rendimenti dei Treasury a lunga scadenza. I timori legati alla rapida crescita del debito pubblico, all'aumento dei costi di finanziamento e alle persistenti pressioni inflazionistiche hanno spinto martedì il rendimento del Treasury trentennale ai massimi degli ultimi 19 anni. ** Alle 16.25, l’indice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) sale dello 0,78%, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) è in rialzo di dello 0,35% e il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) guadagna lo 0,04%. ** Ad agosto l’indice Pmi manifatturiero di S&P Global è sceso a 53,2, al di sotto delle stime degli economisti intervistati da Reuters, che indicavano 53,9.

item.title: Usa, servizi alimentano accelerazione attività economica - S&P Global
item.description: Ad agosto il settore dei servizi statunitense registra la crescita più sostenuta degli ultimi due anni, alimentando una forte accelerazione all'attività economica complessiva.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ad agosto il settore dei servizi statunitense registra la crescita più sostenuta degli ultimi due anni, alimentando una forte accelerazione all'attività economica complessiva. Il dato compensa il rallentamento del manifatturiero, penalizzato dalla riduzione delle scorte e dalle interruzioni delle forniture causate dal conflitto tra Stati Uniti e Iran. I dati relativi all’indice dei responsabili degli acquisti (Pmi) pubblicati da S&P Global suggeriscono che, a quasi due terzi del terzo trimestre, la crescita economica statunitense è sulla buona strada per raddoppiare il tasso di espansione annualizzato dell'1,5% registrato nel secondo trimestre. S&P Global ha comunicato che l'indice Pmi flash nel settore dei servizi è salito a 56,8, il livello più alto dal dicembre 2024, rispetto al 54,6 di luglio, spingendo l'indice composito della produzione a 56,0, il massimo dall’aprile 2022, rispetto al 54,5 del mese scorso. La solidità del terziario più che compensa il calo del Pmi manifatturiero, sceso a 53,2 — ai minimi degli ultimi cinque mesi — dal 53,9 di luglio. Valori superiori a 50 segnalano un'espansione dell'attività. Gli economisti intervistati da Reuters si aspettavano un calo del Pmi dei servizi a 54 dopo che a luglio la lettura era stata sostenuta da fattori straordinari come i Mondiali di calcio e le celebrazioni del 250° anniversario dell'Indipendenza americana. Per il manifatturiero, le previsioni indicavano un valore di 53,9. Le nuove attività nel settore dei servizi crescono al ritmo più sostenuto dal dicembre 2024, consentendo alle assunzioni di registrare il maggiore incremento degli ultimi 19 mesi. Il manifatturiero continua invece a risentire delle tensioni generate dal conflitto con l'Iran, che ha portato alla chiusura dello Stretto di Hormuz, interrompendo i flussi di materie prime e facendo salire i prezzi dell'energia. La crescita degli ordini, balzata dopo l'avvio del conflitto, circa sei mesi fa, quando le aziende si sono affrettate a ricostituire le scorte, rallenta per il quarto mese consecutivo e la crescita della produzione manifatturiera tocca il livello più basso degli ultimi 13 mesi. Sul fronte dell'inflazione, le pressioni si sono allentate, anche se i tassi di crescita sia dei costi di produzione che dei prezzi di vendita restano elevati. Nonostante il calo registrato ad agosto, l'aumento medio dei costi nel terzo trimestre supera ancora leggermente quello del secondo.

item.title: EPA extends renewable fuel standard compliance deadline for refiners
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency plans to extend a September 1 deadline requiring oil refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending laws, the agency said on Friday, in a move that could provide the industry more flexibility as it grapples with elevated compliance costs.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: The Environmental Protection Agency plans to extend a September 1 deadline requiring oil refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending laws, the agency said on Friday, in a move that could provide the industry more flexibility as it grapples with elevated compliance costs. The agency did not give additional details on the new compliance deadline, but said it would be included in a formal action that it will issue at a later date. The agency also said it intends to issue all pending small refinery exemption decisions for 2025 by the end of August, a highly-awaited decision by the industry.

item.title: England rout Pakistan to go one up in test series
item.description: England crushed Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs to win a one-sided first test at Headingley and launch Joe Root’s second spell as permanent captain in style.
item.dc:creator: Neil Squires
item.content:encoded: England crushed Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs to win a one-sided first test at Headingley and launch Joe Root’s second spell as permanent captain in style. The convulsions which accompanied the series defeat by New Zealand eight weeks ago, with Ben Stokes stepping down and coach Brendon McCullum being relieved of his red-ball duties, were emphatically put behind them by England. A dominant display against a hugely disappointing Pakistan side saw the game wrapped up before tea on the third day despite the loss of more than half a day's play to rain. After England had added 43 runs to their overnight score to reach 409 and gain a first innings lead of 238, their pace attack routed the tourists. Mohammad Rizwan top scored with 41 as Pakistan were bowled out for 135 in 37.3 overs. England's Josh Tongue, who was playing in The Hundred final three days before the start of the test match, finished with 3-43 and Ollie Robinson 3-29. Their match figures of 8-89 and 8-80 respectively were test-career bests. For the second time in the match, Pakistan lost their first wicket without a run on the board as Imam-ul-Haq gloved Jofra Archer to wicketkeeper Jamie Smith in the second over and it was something of a procession thereafter. In Archer’s second over, Azan Awais was caught at leg slip by Root, who had just moved himself there in a prescient piece of captaincy. It was Root’s 219th test catch, taking him back ahead of Australia's Steve Smith atop the all-time non-wicketkeeper list. Everything Root touched turned to gold with Saud Shakeel clipping Tongue to an unusual backward square leg position where Dan Lawrence took a fine diving catch. When Shan Masood went for 29 from 56 balls, edging Tongue to Ben Duckett at slip, the Nottinghamshire quick was on a hat-trick for the second time in the match. Salman Ali Agha foiled the attempt but the Pakistan captain was trapped lbw later in the over. Everything was going England’s way and when Ali Usman nicked Robinson into wicketkeeper Jamie Smith’s leg, the ball ricocheted into the diving Jamie Cox’s hands at slip. Cox took another sharp catch off Robinson to remove Khurram Shahzad before Archer, who took 3-50, dismissed Mohammad Abbas to finish the match. For Pakistan, the shared series in the West Indies earlier this month was made to look like a false dawn. The gulf between the penetration of the two sides' seam attacks, the comfort of the two batting lineups in English conditions and their athleticism in the field was glaring. The second test in the three-match series starts at Lord’s on Thursday when Pakistan will hope to have captain Babar Azam back after a finger injury.

item.title: Apple paid 40% of its global taxes to Ireland in last fiscal year
item.description: Apple paid Ireland $17.1 billion in taxes last year, representing around 40% of its worldwide total, according to a company filing that detailed the iPhone maker's global tax liabilities country-by-country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Apple paid Ireland $17.1 billion in taxes last year, representing around 40% of its worldwide total, according to a company filing that detailed the iPhone maker's global tax liabilities country-by-country. Apple said the amount paid to Ireland was "significantly higher" than income taxes accrued as it included €13 billion ($15.18 billion) in back taxes that it was ordered to pay Ireland by European Union's top court in 2024. Ireland fought the EU back-tax bill alongside Apple for eight years, seeking to defend its position as the location of choice for U.S. multinationals in Europe - and the billions of euros in direct and indirect taxes they bring in each year. In 2016, the European Commission's competition chief at the time, Margrethe Vestager, accused Ireland of having granted Apple illegal tax benefits, unfairly diverting investment away from other countries. Apple paid $43.2 billion in income taxes worldwide in the fiscal year that ended in September 2025. ($1 = 0.8562 euros)

item.title: ‘Victory for journalism’: Prince Harry ordered to pay £9.54 million as Daily Mail lawsuit fails
item.description: BRITAIN-ROYALS-HARRY:Prince Harry and others ordered to pay millions over failed lawsuit
item.dc:creator: Sounak Mukhopadhyay
item.content:encoded: By Michael Holden and William JamesLONDON, Aug 21 (Reuters) - Britain's Prince Harry, singer Elton John and other high-profile claimants face paying millions of dollars out of their own pockets to cover the legal costs of the Daily Mail's publisher after a judge ruled their failed privacy lawsuits were conducted in an unreasonable way.Judge Matthew Nicklin's judgment on costs, which was published on Friday, ordered an interim payment from the claimants of £9.54 million, due by August 28, towards the legal costs of Associated Newspapers.In a further damaging blow, Nicklin said the additional costs should be paid on an "indemnity basis", meaning Associated does not need to show they were reasonable and proportionate.Last month, Nicklin comprehensively rejected the case brought by King Charles' younger son, John and five other figures, rejecting allegations that the Mail titles had engaged in widespread unlawful activities, such as phone hacking.The full extent of the payments due to Associated was not announced on Friday. If it cannot be agreed between the parties, Associated's costs will be assessed in separate proceedings.JUDGMENT COMES AS HARRY IS SET TO MOVE BACK TO UKThe ruling comes days after the surprise news that Harry, who stepped down from official duties in 2020, will return with his wife Meghan and their two children to live in Britain from their current home in California.Nicklin, explaining the decision on costs, was highly critical of the way the claimants' case had been put, including that serious allegations had rested on "speculative and inferential" foundations and had not been withdrawn when they were no longer being pursued."In my judgment, the cumulative effect of these matters takes the case well outside the norm. The conduct was unreasonable to a high degree," Nicklin said.A spokesman for Associated Newspapers called the ruling "another overwhelming victory for the Mail and its journalism".A spokesperson for Harry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In July he called the dismissal of the lawsuit "a complete and obvious whitewash".The prince, 41, has long blamed the press for the 1997 Paris car crash that killed his mother, Princess Diana, and compared her treatment to that of his American wife Meghan. Holding back tears in the witness box in January, he said the Daily Mail had made Meghan's life "an absolute misery".He had previously won against the publisher of the Daily Mirror tabloid and had settled a claim with Rupert Murdoch's British newspaper arm, but the latest ruling is a significant defeat in his battles with the media.CLAIMANTS' INSURANCE POLICY FALLS SHORT OF ESTIMATED COSTSThe court was told at a hearing in July that Associated had incurred a legal bill of £34.5 million ($45.8 million), while Harry and other claimants only had an insurance policy which covered £16 million.Associated's lawyer Antony White argued the claimants had made wide-ranging and serious, "egregious" allegations without supporting evidence which had added to their costs.He also said Harry's statement following the ruling was an abuse of his position and celebrity status.Nicholas Bacon, the lawyer for the claimants, said in their submissions that Associated's £34.5 million legal bill was "eye-watering", far exceeding an agreed budget.In his ruling rejecting Harry and the others' lawsuits following an 11-week trial, Nicklin said the claimants had needed to prove that information published about them had been obtained unlawfully. He said they had failed to do so and that suspicion alone was not enough.No decision has yet been made on whether the claimants will appeal.(Reporting by Michael Holden and William James; editing by Kate Holton and Gareth Jones)

item.title: Scholar Rock withdraws Europe filing for muscle weakness drug, plans resubmission
item.description: Scholar Rock said on Friday it withdrew its European application for the experimental spinal muscular atrophy drug and plans to resubmit it with a different manufacturing site after issues at a Novo Nordisk-owned facility .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Scholar Rock (SRRK.O) said on Friday it withdrew its European application for the experimental spinal muscular atrophy drug and plans to resubmit it with a different manufacturing site after issues at a Novo Nordisk-owned facility (NOVOb.CO) . Last year, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration declined to approve apitegromab after identifying manufacturing issues during an inspection of the Bloomington, Indiana facility, which has been operated by Novo since 2024 following its acquisition of Catalent. The company plans to resubmit the application with an alternative manufacturing site to support "the most expeditious path" to a review by the European Medicines Agency's Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use. Scholar Rock said it has also removed the Indiana facility from its U.S. FDA application, and continues to expect an approval decision by the regulator's September 30 target action date. It added it has enough commercial supply from an alternative U.S. manufacturing site and is prepared to launch the drug immediately if approved. Japan's drug regulator has said no additional studies in Japanese patients are needed before the company seeks approval for apitegromab. The company expects to file for approval in Japan by the end of 2026. Apitegromab met the main goal of a late-stage trial and could become the first treatment designed to directly improve muscle strength in people with spinal muscular atrophy if approved.

item.title: Mourinho volta com palavras tranquilas e atitude firme, enquanto Real Madrid inicia reformulação
item.description: José Mourinho chegou à sua primeira coletiva de imprensa no Real Madrid três minutos antes do horário marcado nesta sexta-feira, mas a mensagem foi deliberada: o comprometimento é inegociável, a competição é inevitável e a frustração com as decisões de escalação não será tolerada.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: José Mourinho chegou à sua primeira coletiva de imprensa no Real Madrid três minutos antes do horário marcado nesta sexta-feira, mas a mensagem foi deliberada: o comprometimento é inegociável, a competição é inevitável e a frustração com as decisões de escalação não será tolerada. Três dias após sua apresentação oficial a portas fechadas, Mourinho enfrentou a imprensa no centro de treinamento do Real em Valdebebas antes da estreia na LaLiga, no sábado, contra o Espanyol, falando por mais de 40 minutos em um tom notavelmente comedido. Apesar de o Real Madrid iniciar a temporada após duas campanhas consecutivas sem títulos e com a pressão crescente sobre o presidente Florentino Pérez, que recentemente garantiu sua reeleição, Mourinho rejeitou a ideia de que o clube esteja tomado pela ansiedade. Em vez disso, ele disse que o clima é de expectativa. “Estamos cansados de jogar amistosos. Não amamos o futebol por causa dos amistosos; estamos todos ansiosos para voltar imediatamente ao futebol competitivo”, disse Mourinho. “Eu não diria que o sentimento aqui é de pressão... É mais como adrenalina. O que é positivo, essa energia. Não sinto pressão. Porque tenho muita confiança no trabalho que realizamos e na vontade e no comprometimento dos jogadores.” RESPONSABILIDADE COLETIVA Mourinho enfatizou repetidamente a importância da responsabilidade coletiva em um elenco repleto de talentos de elite, ao mesmo tempo em que deixou claro que as ambições individuais devem ficar em segundo plano em relação à equipe. “O que precisamos é não negociar coisas que não são negociáveis. O comprometimento é obrigatório”, disse ele. “A equipe deve vir antes dos sentimentos pessoais. Amanhã será a primeira vez que os jogadores terão que lidar com isso. Não posso começar uma partida com 15 jogadores." “Não quero decisões fáceis, como deixar no banco um jogador que ficou frustrado por não ter jogado o tempo que achava que jogaria. Quero tomar decisões difíceis, quero jogadores que não caiam na armadilha da frustração. Quero jogadores que se esforcem mais para conquistar uma vaga no time.” Mourinho também abordou o desafio de acomodar Kylian Mbappé, Jude Bellingham e Vinicius Jr. no mesmo time, mantendo o equilíbrio. “Não acho que essas posições sejam incompatíveis; estou muito confiante de que teremos uma ótima temporada”, disse Mourinho. “É óbvio que não posso montar o time em torno de cada um deles, como o Brasil faz com o Vini, a França com Mbappé e a Inglaterra com Bellingham. É mais difícil para mim encontrar um lugar para os três, mas é assim que as coisas estão.” Mourinho disse que também encerrou o assunto da briga no vestiário entre Aurélien Tchouameni e Federico Valverde no final da última temporada, afirmando que ambos os jogadores o haviam convencido de que não havia necessidade de negociações de paz. “Com eles, decidi começar do zero”, disse Mourinho. “Desde que Tchouameni chegou, tenho acompanhado tudo de perto e não senti necessidade de dizer nada. Observei de longe e tudo o que vi foi total normalidade. O que vi foi paz, amizade, companheirismo. Como se nada tivesse acontecido.” (Reportagem de Fernando Kallas)

item.title: Wall Street sube, pero se encamina a pérdida semanal por aumento del rendimientos de los bonos
item.description: Los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses subían el viernes tras la fuerte caída de la víspera, aunque los mercados siguen encaminados a cerrar la semana a la baja, ya que el elevado rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales y las tensiones geopolíticas debilitaban la tolerancia al riesgo.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses subían el viernes tras la fuerte caída de la víspera, aunque los mercados siguen encaminados a cerrar la semana a la baja, ya que el elevado rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales y las tensiones geopolíticas debilitaban la tolerancia al riesgo. * A las 1350 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) ganaba 361,71 puntos, o un 0,68%, a 53.119,88 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) mejoraba 29,02 puntos, o un 0,39%, a 7.670,18 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avanzaba 49,29 puntos, o un 0,19%, a 26.116,66 unidades. * El S&P y el Nasdaq, con gran peso del sector tecnológico, están en camino de romper una racha alcista de tres semanas, mientras que el Dow se dirige hacia su segunda pérdida semanal consecutiva y su mayor declive semanal desde mediados de marzo. * Los valores financieros eran los que más impulsaban el mercado en la sesión. Los grandes bancos JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) y Goldman Sachs (GS.N) sumaban un 1,2% y un 2,3%, respectivamente, mientras que el índice bancario del S&P 500 (.SPXBK) mejoraba un 1,1%. * La plataforma para inversores particulares Robinhood (HOOD.O) se disparaba un 12,4%. El operador de criptoactivos Coinbase Global (COIN.O) ganaba un 9,5% y Strategy (MSTR.O) , un 7,4%, mientras que el bitcóin alcanzaba su nivel más alto desde finales de mayo. * La mayoría de las acciones de gran capitalización y de crecimiento también avanzaban, con alzas superiores al 1% de Meta (META.O) y Tesla (TSLA.O) . * Las tecnológicas se encaminan a registrar un rendimiento inferior al del resto de sectores esta semana, lastradas por el repunte de los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro a más largo plazo. * La preocupación por el aumento desmesurado de la deuda pública, el encarecimiento de los costos de financiación y los persistentes temores de inflación impulsaron el martes el retorno de las notas a 30 años hasta su máximo en 19 años.

item.title: France warns of 300,000 potentially unsafe condoms
item.description: French anti-fraud and health agencies issued a warning on Friday against tens of thousands of potentially unsafe condoms sold on the internet and in shops and pharmacies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French anti-fraud and health agencies issued a warning on Friday against tens of thousands of potentially unsafe condoms sold on the internet and in shops and pharmacies. The agencies recalled about 260,000 condoms sold in pharmacies and shops after lab tests found two products presented risks of bursting or the presence of perforations, they said in a statement. They advised people who have used the condoms to get screened for sexually transmitted diseases and take a pregnancy test in case of a missed period. The anti-fraud agency, known as DGCCRF and the health agency, DGS, also found 30 condom lines listed on online marketplaces which lack the EU conformity seal or labelling in French. Of these, about 1,000 boxes, containing more than 40,000 condoms had already been sold, the statement said. The platforms have agreed to remove the listings, the statement said. The warning included a list of brands of non-compliant condoms, including two made by Japanese company Okamoto Industries (5122.T) and the brands My Lubie and Friday Bae by Passage du Desir. Okamoto Industries and Passage du Desir did not immediately respond to requests by Reuters for comment.

item.title: CDU-Landeschef fordert EU-Einfuhrzölle für chinesische Hybridautos
item.description: Der niedersächsische CDU-Landesvorsitzende Sebastian Lechner fordert schnelle EU-Einfuhrzölle für chinesische Hybridautos. "Genau bei diesen Hybriden gibt es derzeit den größten Importdruck durch chinesische Automobile", sagte Lechner am Freitag im Interview mit der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Eine OECD-Studie habe gerade bestätigt, dass die Marktanteile der chinesischen Produkte im Ausland zu rund 60 Prozent durch Subventionen begründet seien. "Das ist eine Wettbewerbsverzerrung in der Handelspolitik. Wir erwarten, dass Kommission und Bundesregierung unsere Handelspolitik gegenüber China anders aufstellen", fügte der Politiker hinzu. "Wir sind für Freihandel, aber für fairen Freihandel, und die Fairness wird seitens Chinas seit Jahren verletzt."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der niedersächsische CDU-Landesvorsitzende Sebastian Lechner fordert schnelle EU-Einfuhrzölle für chinesische Hybridautos. "Genau bei diesen Hybriden gibt es derzeit den größten Importdruck durch chinesische Automobile", sagte Lechner am Freitag im Interview mit der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Eine OECD-Studie habe gerade bestätigt, dass die Marktanteile der chinesischen Produkte im Ausland zu rund 60 Prozent durch Subventionen begründet seien. "Das ist eine Wettbewerbsverzerrung in der Handelspolitik. Wir erwarten, dass Kommission und Bundesregierung unsere Handelspolitik gegenüber China anders aufstellen", fügte der Politiker hinzu. "Wir sind für Freihandel, aber für fairen Freihandel, und die Fairness wird seitens Chinas seit Jahren verletzt." In Niedersachsen spielt das Thema für den in Wolfsburg ansässigen VW (VOWG.DE) -Konzern eine wichtige Rolle. Für E-Autos aus China gibt es bereits Einfuhrzölle. "Es müssen jetzt schnell EU-Zölle für Hybridautos aus China kommen", sagte Lechner. Das sei eine Lücke, die angesichts der Entwicklung nicht mehr hinnehmbar sei. "Wir müssen da dringend ein Wettbewerbsverfahren einleiten." Lechner räumte ein, dass ein Handelsstreit mit China in anderen Bereichen Nachteile bringen könne, etwa durch chinesische Vergeltungsmaßnahmen. "Aber man muss den Zollweg gehen. Die Situation so laufen zu lassen, wie sie jetzt ist, ist kein Weg", betonte er. Europa müsse eine Antwort finden. "Ansonsten droht, dass wir in fünf bis zehn Jahren aufwachen und Strukturen zerschlagen worden sind, die wir auch nie wieder aufbauen können." Auf dem chinesischen Automarkt wachse das Segment der Hybridfahrzeuge mittlerweile am schnellsten, etwa durch den Einsatz sogenannter Range-Extender. VW habe zu sehr auf reine Elektrofahrzeuge gesetzt, auch unter Einfluss der rot-grünen Landesregierung, kritisierte Lechner. Er äußerte zugleich Erwartungen an EU-Kommissionspräsidentin Ursula von der Leyen, "meiner eigenen Parteifreundin": Es müsse geklärt werden, wie lange Verbrennermotoren in Europa noch zugelassen werden und ob Freiraum für die Hybridtechnik geschaffen werde. Man brauche von der EU-Kommission keine Vorgaben für den CO2-Ausstoß von Unternehmensflotten. Eine Regulierung auf europäischer Ebene müsse es den Autokonzernen in Deutschland erlauben, "sich entsprechend des Marktes aufzustellen".

item.title: Homem armado com espada fere várias pessoas em escola de ensino médio na Suécia
item.description: Um homem armado com uma espada feriu várias pessoas em uma escola de ensino médio sueca na sexta-feira, e uma pessoa foi detida posteriormente, informaram as autoridades locais.
item.dc:creator: Johan Ahlander
item.content:encoded: Um homem armado com uma espada feriu várias pessoas em uma escola de ensino médio sueca na sexta-feira, e uma pessoa foi detida posteriormente, informaram as autoridades locais. O incidente ocorreu na tarde de sexta-feira na escola de ensino médio Brinell, que conta com cerca de 450 alunos com idades entre 16 e 20 anos, na cidade de Fagersta, no centro da Suécia. “Foi recebida uma chamada sobre um caso de violência letal em andamento em uma escola em Fagersta”, informou a polícia em comunicado, acrescentando que uma pessoa no local foi posteriormente detida. Um porta-voz da polícia disse à Reuters que não havia mais perigo para a população. Várias outras escolas e prédios públicos em Fagersta foram colocados em confinamento após o ataque com espada. Citando fontes anônimas, o jornal Expressen informou que a polícia teria atirado no suspeito do caso, mas a Reuters não pôde confirmar imediatamente a informação. O incidente ocorre um ano após um tiroteio em uma escola em Orebro, também na região central da Suécia, quando um atirador matou 10 pessoas antes de atirar em si mesmo, no pior ataque a tiros em massa da história da Suécia. O governo sueco está em contato próximo com a polícia após o ataque de sexta-feira, afirmou o ministro da Justiça, Gunnar Strommer, em comunicado à Reuters. “Toda a Suécia está solidária com Fagersta neste momento difícil”, disse a líder do Partido Trabalhista, Magdalena Andersson, cuja coalizão de centro-esquerda mantém uma clara liderança nas pesquisas de opinião antes das eleições parlamentares do próximo mês.

item.title: Nvidia invests in data center developer Cloverleaf Infrastructure
item.description: Nvidia has made a minority investment in privately held Cloverleaf Infrastructure to develop infrastructure to power AI data center projects across the U.S., the companies said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) has made a minority investment in privately held Cloverleaf Infrastructure to develop infrastructure to power AI data center projects across the U.S., the companies said on Friday. The investment will help Cloverleaf develop sites for the data centers, while Nvidia will support infrastructure buildouts for AI computing. Financial terms of the investment were not disclosed. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier in the day that Nvidia was expected to invest several hundred million dollars in Cloverleaf Infrastructure, citing people familiar with the deal. Cloverleaf works with utilities, energy providers and investors to secure power and other infrastructure for data center sites. The company said it has delivered multiple gigawatt-scale projects across North America since its founding in 2024. Cloverleaf will deploy Nvidia's DSX platform to optimize decisions on site selection, power, cooling and computing infrastructure. The deal comes days after Nvidia said it [USN:L6N44E0NO TEXT:"will invest $1.5 billion"] in SoftBank-owned data center developer SB Energy.

item.title: UK economy hands Burnham surprise boost before first budget
item.description: Britain is showing surprising signs of strength among businesses and consumers, in an early boost for new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, despite the country's vulnerability to high inflation stemming from the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Andy Bruce
item.content:encoded: Britain is showing surprising signs of strength among businesses and consumers, in an early boost for new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, despite the country's vulnerability to high inflation stemming from the Iran war . A closely watched business survey on Friday showed the services sector — the engine of the economy — recorded its [USN:ZRN00EEKB TEXT:"best growth in six months"], confounding expectations for a slowdown in a Reuters poll of economists. Another report showed consumer confidence hitting a [USN:S8N42Q0BZ TEXT:"two-year high"] this month. While economists still think Britain faces big challenges in the months ahead — its public finances remain strained and borrowing costs could increase further — the recent data nonetheless represent a boon for Burnham and for finance minister John Healey ahead of his first budget in October. "If we're not careful, we might have to stop talking about resilience and actually start talking about a reasonable economic performance this year," said Thomas Pugh, chief economist at tax and consultancy firm RSM. ECONOMIC GROWTH AND BUSINESS SENTIMENT IMPROVE [USN:L8N44A0CX TEXT:"Britain's economy expanded by 0.3%"] in June and 0.4% over the second quarter as a whole, led by the services sector. It put Britain on track for the fastest growth among the Group of Seven advanced economies for the first half of this year, although some economists think this may reflect an inadequate seasonal adjustment — which, if borne out, would drag on growth in the second half of the year. The Office for National Statistics noted [USN:L8N44A0Z2 TEXT:"strong investment in tech equipment"] and growth in industries associated with the AI boom, a sign that the impact of this in Britain is starting to become visible in the hard data. On Friday the S&P Global Purchasing Managers' Index for the services sector rose to a six-month high of 52.8, up from 52.1 in July and above all forecasts in the Reuters poll of economists. The Confederation of British Industry's gauge of monthly manufacturing order books rose to its highest level since November 2024, bolstered by the strongest export orders in four years. CONSUMERS GROW MORE OPTIMISTIC Market research firm GfK said its consumer confidence index rose to -14 in August from -17 in July and its gauge of major purchase sentiment increased to its highest since December 2021. Other similar surveys from YouGov/Cebr, BRC-Opinium, Barclays and LSEG/Ipsos have all shown an improving mood in British households over the last month. And while official data on Friday showed a 0.9% drop in [USN:L8N44I06W TEXT:"retail sales volumes"] excluding automotive fuels in July, it followed a period of strong growth. In the three months to July they were 4% higher than a year previously — the strongest growth on this measure in five years. INFLATION, PUBLIC FINANCES REMAIN FLIES IN THE OINTMENT The biggest risks to Healey as he prepares his budget are still inflation and the state of the public finances, which are inextricably linked as worries about persistent price rises have pushed the cost of new government borrowing in most advanced economies to near their highest in decades. [USN:L8N44G0AM TEXT:"Consumer price growth"] looks almost certain to head past 3% in the coming months, and with no end in sight to the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran it remains to be seen how much further global energy prices can rise. Friday's PMI surveys showed a pickup in gauges of corporate price pressures. Britain's government recorded an [USN:L8N44I06T TEXT:"unexpected budget deficit"] last month, according to data on Friday that showed government spending linked to inflation — such as staff costs — had counteracted strong inflows of income tax receipts. Borrowing for the first four months of the 2026/27 financial year is a couple of billion pounds higher than projected by the official budget forecaster, but that picture could change. The ONS has revised down its estimates for public sector net borrowing compared with the initial reading in every month this calendar year. Borrowing in May and June has been revised down by £7.5 billion combined.

item.title: VW-Chef Blume: Unsere Lage ist mehr als kritisch
item.description: Bei Volkswagen gibt es nach den Worten von Konzernchef Oliver Blume dringenden Handlungsbedarf. Die Lage sei mehr als kritisch, sagte Blume in einem im Intranet veröffentlichten Interview, das der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Freitag vorlag. Die Rendite von 3,8 Prozent sei im gegenwärtigen Umfeld zwar solide, reiche aber nicht aus, um dauerhaft ausreichende Mittel für neue Technologien und Produkte zu erwirtschaften.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bei Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) gibt es nach den Worten von Konzernchef Oliver Blume dringenden Handlungsbedarf. Die Lage sei mehr als kritisch, sagte Blume in einem im Intranet veröffentlichten Interview, das der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Freitag vorlag. Die Rendite von 3,8 Prozent sei im gegenwärtigen Umfeld zwar solide, reiche aber nicht aus, um dauerhaft ausreichende Mittel für neue Technologien und Produkte zu erwirtschaften. Der Konzern sei überdimensioniert, zu langsam und zu kompliziert, sagte der Manager. "Wir stemmen gerade das umfassendste Zukunftsprogramm in der Geschichte unseres Unternehmens", sagte er. Dafür sei ein eindeutiges Mandat des Aufsichtsrats nötig, dem Vorstand "Vertrauen, Verantwortung und uneingeschränkte Handlungsfähigkeit zu geben und den eingeschlagenen Weg konzernweit mitzutragen".

item.title: FIFA castiga a Argentina por lienzo sobre Malvinas y a Paredes por incidentes en la final
item.description: La Comisión Disciplinaria de la FIFA sancionó a la Asociación de Fútbol de Argentina (AFA) con una multa de 321.000 dólares, por el comportamiento de los jugadores de su selección, que enarbolaron un lienzo por la disputa de las islas Malvinas tras el triunfo sobre Inglaterra en el pasado Mundial de Fútbol.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Disciplinaria de la FIFA sancionó a la Asociación de Fútbol de Argentina (AFA) con una multa de 321.000 dólares, por el comportamiento de los jugadores de su selección, que enarbolaron un lienzo por la disputa de las islas Malvinas tras el triunfo sobre Inglaterra en el pasado Mundial de Fútbol. La sanción, por "servirse de un evento deportivo para realizar manifestaciones de índole distinta a la deportiva" también consideró "cánticos y gestos discriminatorios de sus aficionados". La selección argentina deberá además jugar los próximos dos partidos de local con la mitad del aforo. Además, el volante argentino Leandro Paredes fue sancionado con 10 partidos de suspensión y una multa de 90.000 dólares, el más fuerte de todos los castigos por los incidentes después de la final en la que España derrotó a Argentina y se coronó campeona del mundo. La FIFA multó y suspendió además a los jugadores argentinos Nahuel Molina y Thiago Almada, y al ayudante técnico de la selección Roberto Ayala por los incidentes. La Comisión también impuso una suspensión de un partido y una multa de 30.000 dólares al centrocampista español Gavi por motivos disciplinarios.

item.title: Tension with South Africa fuels prospect of better play, says All Blacks captain
item.description: The increasing tension between hosts South Africa and the touring New Zealand team ahead of Saturday's first test will serve to get the best out of the two sides, All Blacks captain Ardie Savea said on the eve of the clash.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gleeson
item.content:encoded: The increasing tension between hosts South Africa and the touring New Zealand team ahead of Saturday's first test will serve to get the best out of the two sides, All Blacks captain Ardie Savea said on the eve of the clash. The match at Ellis Park, where the Springboks narrowly beat New Zealand to win the World Cup in extra time in 1995, is the first of four tests in the ‘Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry’ series which sees the Kiwis embarking on a full-scale tour of South Africa for the first time in 30 years. “The stakes are high and there's a lot of hype and edge around the game but, for me, I think that brings the best out of all players," Savea told a press conference on Friday. “We respect the Springboks, they’re a real class outfit but also I believe we’re going to have just as much quality. Hopefully, we go out there and put on a spectacle.” There has been increasing antagonism in the build-up to Saturday’s game with both camps using their press conferences to try and score a few psychological points. New Zealand have complained that South African sides slow the pace down and the Boks retorted with claims of illegal breakdown tactics by the All Blacks, which has served to drive up the social media hype around the contest. Savea said they would look to feed off what is expected to be an antagonistic crowd at the iconic Johannesburg venue. “All that noise can either go both ways. You let it drown you out and you're like a deer in the headlights or you can love those moments. “We know what's coming and we know what we need to do but we as All Blacks love those moments, but it's not going to be easy at all,” he said. The 32-year-old Savea did not play in the first three tour games against provincial opposition as he was given a fortnight to stay in New Zealand and rest after the Nations Championship matches against France, Italy and Ireland in July. Savea said he did not realise he needed the break from the game until he was home immersed in domestic duties. “Just being a dad, drop-offs, pickups, helping the wife where she needs me around the house. Kind of those things that are taken for granted when you're always on the go, so it was really nice being at home. “But at the same time, you watch the boys from afar, and you wish you were there too, so I'm really blessed to be back in the environment around the team, and just trying to add to the energy that's already been here,” he said. (This story has been refiled to add the byline)

item.title: Diamondbacks determined to close difficult week with success against Reds
item.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks will return home Friday night to open a three-game series against the Cincinnati Reds with hopes of nudging back into a National League wild-card spot.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Arizona Diamondbacks will return home Friday night to open a three-game series against the Cincinnati Reds with hopes of nudging back into a National League wild-card spot. The team came back to Phoenix after losing two of three games against the Red Sox in Boston without All-Star infielder Ketel Marte, who worried the Diamondbacks when he didn't show up at Fenway Park for Monday's game. In an odd series of events, Marte was placed on the restricted list, then moved to the 10-day injured list on Thursday after an MRI showed inflammation in his left knee. The club still hasn't revealed much about the Marte situation, even after Marte, his agent, Diamondbacks general manager Mike Hazen and manager Torey Lovullo met Thursday afternoon. "I'm not gonna get into specifics," Hazen said of the discussion. "I feel like the conversation and meeting was productive. We discussed the last week. That, obviously, I'm not going to get into. He'll talk to his teammates at some point, and we'll go from there." Now, the Diamondbacks will try to turn the focus back to the field and to the Reds after a week of unforeseen occurrences. On Wednesday night, after their 7-6, 10-inning win over the Red Sox, the players were forced to spend the night in Las Vegas when their plane was re-routed due to thunderstorms in Phoenix. For the Diamondbacks, it's back to business. "We're going to be fine no matter who's in that lineup," Lovullo said. "We got 26 engaged dogs out there that want to win a baseball game, and that's all I care about. Arizona's Eduardo Rodriguez (12-4, 2.71 ERA) is set to oppose fellow left-hander Nick Lodolo (3-2, 4.52) in the series opener on Friday. The Diamondbacks (67-61) are one game behind the San Diego Padres (68-60) and three behind the Philadelphia Phillies (70-58) for the NL's final two wild-card spots. Arizona entered play last Saturday tied with the Padres for the second wild card. The Reds, meanwhile, have lost five of their past seven games, most recently an excruciating 10-9 home loss to the St. Louis Cardinals on Thursday when Reds center fielder Dane Myers dropped a fly ball with two outs and two on in the ninth and the Reds leading 5-4. From there, the Reds scored four more times, but reliever Brock Burke was charged with six unearned runs and the loss. "He just didn't look it into his glove," Reds manager Terry Francona said of Myers. "'(Burke) probably had a little bit of a letdown there. He thinks not only is the inning over, the game's over." The Reds' attempt to climb back from a 10-5 deficit in the bottom of the ninth fell just short. Now, the Reds must deal with Rodriguez. He has made 16 quality starts, tied for fourth in the majors, and has beaten the division-leading Los Angeles Dodgers and Atlanta Braves in his past two outings. He has faced the Reds once this year, when he walked a season-high five batters in 2 2/3 innings of the Diamondbacks' 5-2 road win on June 12. Rodriguez threw 40 pitches in the first inning and 85 overall in the short stint. Rodriguez is 1-1 with a 3.05 ERA in four career starts against Cincinnati. Lodolo will make his third start after being sidelined by a recurring blister on his left index finger. He gave up three hits in five scoreless innings the last time out, walking away with a no-decision in the Reds' 7-1 loss to Miami on Sunday. He threw 73 pitches before being pulled. "I understand it," Lodolo said. "It's a process, and I'm building up." Lodolo went head-to-head with Rodriguez on June 12, giving up two runs in 5 1/3 innings and taking a no-decision in Cincinnati's loss. He is 0-0 with a 3.97 ERA in two career starts against Arizona. --Field Level Media

item.title: Retracción de riesgo país ayuda a mejora en títulos de Argentina
item.description: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba a un pausado sesgo alcista el viernes por compras de oportunidades ante una mejora en el riesgo país y fuertes pérdidas recientes en los activos domésticos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba a un pausado sesgo alcista el viernes por compras de oportunidades ante una mejora en el riesgo país y fuertes pérdidas recientes en los activos domésticos. La presión alcista en las tasas de interés de Estados Unidos, las intrigas geopolíticas en Oriente Medio y ciertas dudas políticas internas de cara a un año electoral, vienen de presionar a la plaza doméstica. En base al referencial del banco J.P. Morgan, el riesgo país cedía a 509 puntos básicos a las 1415 GMT, luego de trepar el jueves hasta las 532 unidades y retomar su máximo en tres meses. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa porteña ganaba un 1,9%, para recortar su pérdida semanal al 0,6%, mientras que los bonos públicos extrabursátiles subían un 0,2% en promedio, con una firme caída durante la semana del 2,3%. "A nivel local, se mira la firmeza en las tasas en pesos (...) mientras que en el plano internacional la recompra de deuda en Estados Unidos modera temporalmente las tasas de interés de largo plazo", reportó Rava Bursátil. Los argentinos acudirán a las urnas en 2027 por elecciones presidenciales, donde el libertario Javier Milei buscará su reelección. Sin que se conozcan nombres de candidatos, la calificadora Moody's reportó que independientemente de quién resulte electo, "es probable que las políticas continúen", ya que las actuales reformas económicas "han pasado de ser un ajuste inicial de carácter cíclico a una mejora más duradera del perfil crediticio soberano". El peso mayorista permanecía equilibrado a 1.498,5 por dólar , con una política cambiaria oficial firme para fijar el piso de la divisa en las 1.500 unidades junto a un accionar diario del banco central (BCRA).

item.title: Liverpool can compete despite need for more signings, says Iraola
item.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said on Friday the club still needed reinforcements out wide before the transfer window closes, but backed his squad to be competitive from the start of the season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said on Friday the club still needed reinforcements out wide before the transfer window closes, but backed his squad to be competitive from the start of the season. Liverpool open their Premier League campaign at Newcastle United on Sunday after a close season in which they brought in centre back Jeremy Jacquet and forward [USN:L4N42Q1LJ TEXT:"Victor Munoz"], while defender [USN:L1N4470P0 TEXT:"Ronald Araujo"] joined on loan. They have lost, however, talisman [USN:L1N40C15L TEXT:"Mohamed Salah"], defenders [USN:L6N40S171 TEXT:"Andy Robertson"] and [USN:L6N42906M TEXT:"Ibrahima Konate"], while midfielder Curtis Jones is also expected to depart. Forward [USN:L1N40Y0UY TEXT:"Hugo Ekitike"] is among several players sidelined by injury. The club have been linked with Paris St Germain forward Bradley Barcola and Brighton & Hove Albion winger Yankuba Minteh as they continue to reshape the squad. "Some situations are clear - on the wing, we need specific players for that. Other positions, we have to be open-minded to situations that can improve our team," Iraola told reporters. "I wanted the players for the first day of pre-season, with every position covered and top-level players throughout. "But you understand how the competition works, that the market is open when you start the season... "You have seen the very good players that we have right now in the building, so we can be competitive from the beginning." The 44-year-old [USN:L1N42C0TK TEXT:"Spaniard takes over from Arne Slot"], whose title-winning debut season after succeeding Juergen Klopp in 2024 was followed by a disappointing fifth-placed finish last term. Liverpool ended the campaign 25 points behind champions Arsenal despite spending around £400 million ($545.52 million) on new signings. "I feel excited," Iraola said. "I can feel it even in the atmosphere when we train with the players, you feel like this week is a little bit different..." RETURN OF ISAK Sunday's match will also mark Alexander Isak's first return to St James' Park since completing a British record £125-million move from Newcastle to Liverpool after a prolonged transfer saga last year. The 26-year-old Sweden international endured an injury-disrupted debut season at Liverpool, scoring four goals and providing one assist in 22 appearances after joining from Newcastle, where he had been frozen out of the first-team squad while awaiting his move to Merseyside. "It's always special when you play against your old team in their stadium," Iraola said. "I think he is in a very good place. He has been training every day and adding more and more minutes with each friendly game. "I think he had a very good World Cup in terms of availability and fitness levels, and I want to keep him there for as long as we can. We know his level and, if we can keep him there, he will score goals and give us a lot." Newcastle will also begin a new chapter under German coach [USN:L6N44215L TEXT:"Matthias Jaissle"] following the departure of [USN:L1N43X0XY TEXT:"Eddie Howe"]. ($1 = 0.7334 pounds)

item.title: Ameaça do El Niño à safra de café do Vietnã não deve ser subestimada, diz associação
item.description: A safra de café robusta do Vietnã para 2026/27 poderá registrar um ligeiro aumento na produção, embora a ameaça representada pelo El Niño deste ano não deva ser subestimada, afirmou Thai Nhu Hiep, vice-presidente da Associação de Café e Cacau do Vietnã, à Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A safra de café robusta do Vietnã para 2026/27 poderá registrar um ligeiro aumento na produção, embora a ameaça representada pelo El Niño deste ano não deva ser subestimada, afirmou Thai Nhu Hiep, vice-presidente da Associação de Café e Cacau do Vietnã, à Reuters. O ligeiro aumento na produção deve ocorrer à medida que as áreas replantadas nos últimos anos entram em fases de produtividades mais estáveis, disse Hiep, que também é presidente e diretor executivo da exportadora vietnamita de café Vinh Hiep Co., Ltd, na noite desta quinta-feira. Embora não tenha apresentado uma previsão de produção própria, Hiep citou o Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos, que estima que a produção de café vietnamita alcance 32 milhões de sacas de 60 kg na safra de 2026/27, sendo a esmagadora maioria composta por café robusta. No entanto, a ameaça do fenômeno climático El Niño não pode ser ignorada, disse Hiep, acrescentando que a região das terras altas centrais do Vietnã é particularmente vulnerável a padrões climáticos extremos durante fases cruciais do ciclo de cultivo. "Para o Vietnã, a adaptação às mudanças climáticas não é mais uma preocupação futura. Tornou-se uma necessidade urgente para salvaguardar a produção de café", disse Hiep durante sua visita ao Brasil para o Vitória Coffee Summit. A indústria cafeeira do Vietnã está colaborando com os produtores para desenvolver um perfil de café robusta de especialidade com foco na qualidade, ajudando os grãos do país a ganharem reconhecimento por suas origens únicas, disse ele. "Acreditamos que essa abordagem aumentará o valor das exportações e, ao mesmo tempo, permitirá que os agricultores obtenham uma parcela maior do valor gerado ao longo de toda a cadeia de suprimentos do café", disse ele. O país também está construindo uma infraestrutura de dados para ajudar a cumprir as regras da União Europeia sobre rastreabilidade, destinadas a prevenir o desmatamento causado por culturas como o café, disse Hiep. Adiada duas vezes devido à sua complexidade, a Regulamentação da União Europeia sobre Desmatamento (EUDR) exige que os importadores de commodities e produtos relacionados comprovem que seus produtos não foram cultivados em terras recentemente desmatadas. "O EUDR não deve ser visto meramente como uma barreira às exportações", disse Hiep. "Ele também representa uma oportunidade para o Vietnã construir uma cadeia de abastecimento de café que seja mais transparente, sustentável e competitiva a longo prazo." (Reportagem de Oliver Griffin)

item.title: Sinner não participará do US Open devido a uma lesão no joelho
item.description: O tenista número um do mundo, Jannik Sinner, anunciou nesta sexta-feira que não participará do US Open, afirmando que não disputará o torneio de Grand Slam devido a uma lesão persistente no joelho.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O tenista número um do mundo, Jannik Sinner, anunciou nesta sexta-feira que não participará do US Open, afirmando que não disputará o torneio de Grand Slam devido a uma lesão persistente no joelho. “Embora eu tenha trabalhado duro com minha equipe e minha equipe médica, tivemos que tomar a difícil decisão de que não poderei disputar o US Open deste ano”, disse Sinner em comunicado divulgado no X. “Voltamos às quadras em Monte Carlo nos últimos dias e percebemos que ainda preciso de mais tempo para me recuperar do problema no joelho direito.” O US Open acontece de 23 de agosto a 13 de setembro. (Reportagem de Karan Prashant Saxena, em Bengaluru)

item.title: Sinner anuncia que no jugará el Abierto de EEUU por una lesión de rodilla
item.description: El número uno del tenis mundial, Jannik Sinner, anunció el viernes que no jugará el Abierto de Estados Unidos debido a una lesión persistente en la rodilla derecha, privando al último Grand Slam de la temporada de uno de sus principales favoritos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El número uno del tenis mundial, Jannik Sinner, anunció el viernes que no jugará el Abierto de Estados Unidos debido a una lesión persistente en la rodilla derecha, privando al último Grand Slam de la temporada de uno de sus principales favoritos. El tenista italiano de 24 años, que se alzó con su quinto título de Grand Slam en Wimbledon el mes pasado, no ha jugado desde que sufrió la lesión a principios de este mes. Se retiró del Abierto de Cincinnati y tampoco participó en el de Canadá, dos torneos clave de preparación sobre pista dura de cara al Grand Slam de Nueva York. "Aunque he estado trabajando duro con mi equipo y mi equipo médico, hemos tenido que tomar la difícil decisión de que no podré competir en el Abierto de Estados Unidos este año", afirmó Sinner en un comunicado publicado en la red social X. "Hemos vuelto a las pistas en Montecarlo durante los últimos días y nos hemos dado cuenta de que todavía necesito más tiempo para recuperarme del problema que tengo en la rodilla derecha", señaló. El anuncio se produce un día después de que el número dos del mundo, Carlos Alcaraz, confirmara que competirá en Flushing Meadows tras cuatro meses fuera de las canchas. El español, que venció a Sinner en la final del Abierto de Estados Unidos del año pasado, se dirige ahora a Nueva York como el jugador mejor clasificado y uno de los favoritos para alzarse con el título, a pesar de sus recientes problemas de lesiones. La ausencia de Sinner elimina a uno de los mayores rivales del español y podría allanarle el camino en su búsqueda de su octava corona de Grand Slam. El Abierto de Estados Unidos se celebrará del 23 de agosto al 13 de septiembre.

item.title: Wall Street se recupera, mas alta nos rendimentos abre caminho para perdas semanais
item.description: Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira após perdas na sessão anterior, embora os mercados ainda estejam a caminho de encerrar a semana em baixa uma vez que os rendimentos elevados dos públicos e as tensões geopolíticas enfraqueciam a tolerância ao risco.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices acionários dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira após perdas na sessão anterior, embora os mercados ainda estejam a caminho de encerrar a semana em baixa uma vez que os rendimentos elevados dos públicos e as tensões geopolíticas enfraqueciam a tolerância ao risco. O S&P 500 (.SPX) e o Nasdaq (.IXIC) devem interromper uma sequência de três semanas de ganhos, enquanto o Dow Jones (.DJI) caminha para a segunda perda semanal consecutiva e sua maior queda semanal desde meados de março. Nesta sexta-feira, as ações do setor financeiro davam o maior impulso ao mercado, com JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) e Goldman Sachs (GS.N) registrando alta de 1,2% e 2,3%, respectivamente. O índice de bancos do S&P 500 (.SPXBK) subia 1,1%. A plataforma para investidores de varejo Robinhood (HOOD.O) avançava 12,4%. A Coinbase Global (COIN.O) subia 9,5% e a Strategy (MSTR.O) registrava alta de 7,4%, enquanto o bitcoin atingiu sua cotação mais alta desde o final de maio. A maioria das ações de megacaps e de crescimento também registrava alta, com a Meta (META.O) e a Tesla (TSLA.O) subindo mais de 1% cada. As ações do setor de tecnologia devem apresentar desempenho inferior ao de seus pares nesta semana, pressionadas por um aumento nos rendimentos dos Treasuries de prazo mais longo. Preocupações com o aumento da dívida pública, custos de financiamento mais altos e temores persistentes de inflação levaram os rendimentos dos Treasuries de 30 anos a uma máxima de 19 anos na terça-feira. O anúncio do secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, na quinta-feira, de que o governo pode aumentar ainda mais suas recompras de títulos após a intervenção surpresa de quarta proporcionou um alívio de curta duração. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,68%, para 53.119,88 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançava 0,39%, a 7.670,18 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 0,19%, para 26.116,66 pontos.

item.title: Sector servicios de EEUU impulsa una aceleración de la actividad empresarial: S&P Global
item.description: El mayor crecimiento registrado en el sector de servicios de Estados Unidos en casi dos años impulsó una fuerte aceleración de la actividad empresarial general en agosto, compensando la desaceleración de las manufactureras, lastradas por la reducción de la acumulación de existencias y las interrupciones en el suministro derivadas de la guerra contra Irán.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mayor crecimiento registrado en el sector de servicios de Estados Unidos en casi dos años impulsó una fuerte aceleración de la actividad empresarial general en agosto, compensando la desaceleración de las manufactureras, lastradas por la reducción de la acumulación de existencias y las interrupciones en el suministro derivadas de la guerra contra Irán. Las encuestas del Índice de Gerentes de Compras (PMI) publicadas el viernes por S&P Global sugieren que, cuando ya ha transcurrido casi dos tercios del actual tercer trimestre, el crecimiento económico general del país va camino de duplicar la tasa de expansión anualizada del 1,5% del segundo trimestre. S&P Global indicó que su índice preliminar de gerentes de compras del sector de servicios subió a 56,8, el nivel más alto desde diciembre de 2024, desde el 54,6 de julio, lo que impulsó su índice compuesto de producción a 56,0, un máximo desde abril de 2022, desde el 54,5 del mes pasado. La fortaleza del sector de servicios compensó con creces el retroceso del PMI manufacturero de S&P, que se situó en 53,2, un mínimo en cinco meses y menos que 53,9 de julio. Las lecturas por sobre 50 indican una expansión de la actividad. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters esperaban que el PMI de servicios bajara al 54,0, frente a julio, que se vio favorecido por el gasto relacionado con la Copa Mundial de la FIFA y la celebración del 250.º aniversario del Día de la Independencia de Estados Unidos, dos factores que no estuvieron presentes en agosto. Las previsiones apuntaban a que el índice manufacturero se mantuviera estable en 53,9. "La actividad empresarial en EEUU está en auge, y las empresas registran en lo que va del tercer trimestre el crecimiento de la producción más rápido en más de cuatro años, ya que la expansión cobró aún más impulso en agosto", dijo en un comunicado Chris Williamson, economista jefe de S&P Global Market Intelligence. "Los datos de la encuesta para el tercer trimestre apuntan actualmente a un crecimiento anualizado cercano al 3,0%, lo que supone un sólido aumento con respecto al ritmo del 1,5% registrado en el segundo trimestre", agregó El crecimiento de la actividad en el sector de los servicios fue el más rápido desde diciembre de 2024, lo que permitió que la contratación en este sector registrara su mayor aumento en 19 meses. En el ámbito industrial, se observaron las continuas tensiones derivadas de la guerra con Irán, que ha provocado el cierre efectivo del vital estrecho de Ormuz, lo que ha interrumpido el flujo de suministros de materias primas clave y ha disparado los precios de la energía. El crecimiento de los pedidos, que se había disparado tras el inicio de la guerra hace casi seis meses, cuando las empresas trataban de reforzar sus existencias, se ralentizó por cuarto mes consecutivo, y el crecimiento de la producción industrial fue el más débil en 13 meses. El informe reveló que las presiones inflacionarias han remitido ligeramente, aunque las tasas de crecimiento tanto de los costos de los insumos como de los precios de venta siguen siendo altas. El aumento promedio de los costos en lo que va del tercer trimestre sigue superando ligeramente al observado en el segundo trimestre, a pesar de la moderación de agosto, según el informe.

item.title: Van de Ven main Tottenham skipper as De Zerbi names five captains
item.description: Tottenham Hotspur's official captain this season will be Micky van de Ven, with manager Roberto de Zerbi on Friday naming the Netherlands international at the head of a five-man leadership group including World Cup-winner Pedro Porro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tottenham Hotspur's official captain this season will be Micky van de Ven, with manager Roberto de Zerbi on Friday naming the Netherlands international at the head of a five-man leadership group including World Cup-winner Pedro Porro. Both players, however, will miss Spurs' opening Premier League game at Brentford on Saturday. The 25-year-old Van de Ven takes over the armband from Argentine Cristian Romero who joined Atletico Madrid this month. "The new captain is Micky van de Ven. The second Pedro Porro, the third Ben Davies, the fourth James Maddison and the fifth Archie Gray," Italian De Zerbi explained. "Why five captains? Just because I want many captains inside of the pitch and to be clear in the position. "Every one of them deserves to be captain or in the group of the captains, but personality and passion is not if you are captain or not captain." Italian De Zerbi arrived near the end of last season with seven games left and the club heading for relegation for the first time since 1977. He instilled some much-needed spirit and completed his survival mission on the final day of the campaign. After a big-money close-season spending spree on the likes of Sandro Tonali, Mateus Fernandes and Jan Paul van Hecke, hopes are high that he can get Tottenham challenging at the other end of the table after successive 17th-placed finishes. Two of his key men will be missing for the trip to Brentford with Van de Ven injured and Porro only just back in training after the right back helped Spain lift the World Cup. "Micky is not on the list tomorrow like Pedro," De Zerbi told reporters. "Today (Van de Ven) worked with us, with the group and he is going very well.
